name: music-piano-roll-spec
description: Piano-roll arrangement spec from annotated lyrics — validates bpm, key, total_bars, section names, chord progressions, energy curves, and instrument presence

cases.notes: Validates structural and harmonic output against Whisperheads piano-roll-spec fixture. Verse energy must be below 0.5; chorus energy must exceed 0.5 to reflect the quiet→loud arc.
